routes.description: Attempt to prove the complete full-dataset GAT forward path in ezkl from public graph inputs and checkpoint-bound weights.

Native ezkl GraphSegmentAttention route over full-dataset CSR/ragged dst segments. C++ exports graph/checkpoint/tensor artifacts; Rust validates CSR layout and attempts native compile/setup/prove/verify without dense NxN, subset, shard, sample, digest, identity, folding, or precomputed logits.

Compressed native ezkl GraphSegmentAttention route over full-dataset CSR/ragged dst segments with deterministic formal lookup tables, row-compressed projection/aggregation checks, batched lookup accounting, and CSR state-machine segment max/sum rows.
Historical fallback class only. Not used as a strict replacement route.
